census: Fifth Rwanda Population and Housing Census (RPHC5), 2022

source.title: RPHC5 2022 Main Indicators, Table 1: Resident population by sex, Province, District and population density
source.publisher: National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (NISR)

licence.where: https://statistics.gov.rw/terms-use, read 2026-11-20: NISR data and analysis released under CC BY 4.0, unless content carries its own licence; the census pages carry no other
licence.redistributed: the counts of Table 1, with attribution to the National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda

transcription.by: read from the workbook's cells (B4:E39), not typed
transcription.as_published: names as the workbook writes them, with a trailing no-break space removed from City of Kigali, Southern Province, Western Province, Northern Province, Eastern Province

units: counts.csv: the country, its 4 provinces and the City of Kigali, and 30 districts. units.csv maps each district to geoBoundaries gbOpen RWA ADM2 (RWA-ADM2-39286606), all 30 by the same name.

reviewed.found: First transcription. RPHC5 (August 2022) is the latest census.

offered.why: Fieldwork offers the table in the units today's maps use, with geoBoundaries' name for each, so a census relates to a map of the districts without anyone retyping a name. The printed counts (counts.csv) stay here as the source, and every check runs on them.

districts.label: Its 30 districts, with geoBoundaries' names
districts.what: The census districts with the name geoBoundaries gives each, written by scripts/districts_today.py. Counts as printed.
districts.how: Each district's name in the NISR workbook is geoBoundaries' RWA ADM2 name (gbOpen 9469f09, in digital-twin-ph/boundaries), all 30; the shapeID is that release's.
does_not_establish: That geoBoundaries' district lines are NISR's: they are OpenStreetMap's, from Open Data Rwanda.
